title: HB1504 (2025-2026 Regular): Enhancing public safety by requiring financial responsibility to purchase or possess a firearm or operate a firearm range.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/biennium/2025-26/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1504.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Sec. 2 (RCW 9.41.090) makes proof of financial responsibility a condition of delivery by a dealer. Sec. 3 creates a licensing-department program; Sec. 4-5 are account-earnings amendments. Takes effect Jan 1, 2027.

operative_text:
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (1)(a) No person in this state may purchase or possess a firearm unless that person is:
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (a) A firearm liability policy or bond under this section must: (i) Be issued by an insurance company or surety company authorized to do business in this state; (ii) provide at least $25,000 of coverage per incident arising from accidental or unintentional discharge of the covered firearm causing injury, death, or property damage; and (iii) identify the specific firearm covered by the policy or bond.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (b) Firearm liability policies and bonds must be obtained on a per-firearm basis, with a separate policy or bond required for each distinct firearm.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (d) Failure to provide proof of financial responsibility to purchase or possess a firearm at the request of a dealer while purchasing a firearm, or at the request of a law enforcement officer while possessing a firearm, is a class 1 civil infraction.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (a) Any person possessing more than 25 firearms may qualify as a self-insurer by obtaining a certificate of self-insurance issued by the department of licensing as provided in (b) of this subsection.
NEW SECTION Sec. 6 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (1) A firearm range operator shall carry a general liability insurance policy providing at least $1,000,000 of coverage per incident.
NEW SECTION Sec. 6 (new RCW section in chapter 9.41): (3) A violation of this section is a misdemeanor.
